snippet.title: Spirits of Baciu - DEMO Trailer ENG
snippet.description:
✨DEMO AVAILABLE ON STEAM! 🎮https://store.steampowered.com/app/2719410/Spirits_of_Baciu/

🍂Spirits of Baciu is the enigmatic adventure of a small, cat-like spirit who suddenly wakes up in the dark forest of Baciu. Help him to find his way through the woods by solving puzzles and confronting the spirits that inhabit this strange place.🐾

🔗All our links here:
https://beacons.ai/hornslevelup

💚Save the Kickstarter campaign: https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hornslevelup/spirits-of-baciu

🎙️Voice acting: Janet Peters
